consensus_summary: Swine primarily symbolize ritual/moral uncleanness and spiritual impurity—the profane who scorn holy things or return to filth—with common extensions to apostates, unreceptive hearers, Gentiles/pagans, and sensual living; minority readings include hypocrisy (cloven hoof without cud), demonic association, and the ravaging boar.
book_summary: Swine are an unclean beast signifying a people or kingdom that bears the outward covenant sign without the inward work (parted hoof without chewing the cud), that tramples what is holy and returns to uncleanness after washing; gathered as a body they are the Synagogue of Satan who say they are Jews and are not.
consensus_core_identification: Uncleanness / spiritual-moral impurity (the unclean or profane person/thing)
book_core_identification: People/kingdom with outward covenant appearance lacking inward reality, identified as the Synagogue of Satan (false Jews)
boundary_disagreement: Consensus applies swine broadly to the unclean, apostates, mockers, Gentiles, and the sensual; the book confines the chief referent to false covenantal claimants who outwardly look like the people of God but are not, i.e. the Synagogue of Satan.
material_contradiction: None; the book retains uncleanness, trampling of the holy, and return to the mire, and does not deny the consensus category—it specializes the referent.
rationale: Both sides start from Levitical uncleanness and the NT images of trampling pearls and the washed sow returning to mire. Consensus treats general impurity as the settled core, with outward-without-inward hypocrisy only a minority alternative. The book preserves that unclean/hypocrisy mechanism but materially narrows extension and precision to a specific religious body—those who claim Jewish/covenant identity without the inward reality—equated with the Synagogue of Satan. This is boundary refinement of the same category, not replacement of the central referent, hence REFINED with BOOK_NARROWS / BOOK_SUBSET.
strongest_objection: Equating swine directly with the Synagogue of Satan (Rev 2:9; 3:9) is an idiosyncratic synthesis not present in the consensus readings; standard symbolism stops at general impurity/hypocrisy rather than that specific corporate identity.
